exported_guarantees.statement: A memory candidate must arise from an experience accessible to that actor; privileged world/event history is not sufficient.
Retention decisions use only actor-accessible checkpoint state and a predeclared selection policy; future-only divergence cannot retroactively change an earlier decision.
Each actor has a finite selected-memory semantic capacity independent of lifetime and distinct-event count; saturation uses deterministic pressure rather than unbounded overflow.
Active consequence reasons cannot escape the finite model through an unlimited side list; they remain bounded in memory or in an explicitly bounded owner-controlled representation.
Selected memory preserves a bounded causal witness sufficient to explain a later consequence without complete biography replay.
Memory may affect a later decision only through an explicitly declared action-family consumer while PA-02 retains choice authority.
Memory may preserve historical reasons but does not own canonical truth, current belief, directed relationship values or ongoing domain obligations.
Player-caused and off-screen experiences use the same actor-access and selection rules; hidden lineage alone cannot alter actor output.
When a consequence remains active, compaction or save/load preserves its necessary bounded reason or an owner-controlled equivalent.
Recovery changes relevance through causal state changes rather than universal amnesia or automatic reset.

exclusions_nonclaims.statement: Memory is not a second mutable truth, present-belief, relationship or obligation store.
Neither distinct salient episodes nor active-reason exceptions may create an unbounded autobiographical side store.
Privileged hidden event or rumour lineage is not actor memory unless legitimately experienced or acquired.
Memory does not force an actor choice or globally search actors and targets; the declared decision owner consumes eligible memory inputs.
PA-06 does not establish exact numeric capacity, TTL, storage schema, save footprint, lookup latency or population-scale performance.

reopen_conditions: A concrete consumer requires complete biography replay to explain a claimed memory consequence.
A later implementation can grow selected memory or active-reason state without a finite bound for distinct valid candidates.
A selection result can change when only future or privileged information changes while checkpoint-available state is fixed.
A later consumer duplicates or mutates current truth, belief, relationship or obligation authority.
escalate_if: A consumer needs exact selection/ranking details beyond the exported semantic guarantees.
A disposition would be reclassified, especially REJECT or LATER rows.
A proposed consumer needs exact retention, capacity, decay, storage, save, lookup or performance values.
Live accepted identity or canonical PA-06 source bytes contradict this capsule.

dispositions.source_key: Causal-time selection from declared dimensions/consumer classes
Finite per-actor selected-memory budget + deterministic pressure policy
Salience by stake, relevance, novelty and declared consumer class
Distinct detail loss, relevance decay and state repair
Active-effect reason pin or owner-controlled equivalent
Direct memory writes to current belief/relationship values
Hidden event or rumour lineage as actor memory
Global one-size-fits-all salience, TTL or slot constants
Final storage schema, compaction/index algorithm and CPU budget
